usage: CodeScene code health rules for this repository. third_party/ holds vendored, minified distributions (see third_party/xterm/VERSION) that are copied verbatim and never edited here, so the function-level heuristics are disabled for them.

rule_sets.matching_content_path_doc: Vendored third-party code, refreshed only with cmake/UpdateXterm.cmake.

rules.name: Lines of Code in a Single File

rule_sets.matching_content_path_doc: A text command-line interface: its API and helpers take command names, help texts and command lines, which are strings by nature. Wrapping them in structs only to lower the ratio would make the public API (terminal.command(name, help, handler)) harder to read.
